fn parse_field<T>(fields: &BTreeMap<String, String>, name: &str) -> Result<T, String>
where
    T: std::str::FromStr,
    T::Err: std::fmt::Display,
{
    required_field(fields, name)?
        .parse()
        .map_err(|error| format!("record {name} is invalid: {error}"))
}
